project_info.theme: Fictional transparent social-profile card held between two fingers
project_info.creative_direction: Futuristic glass or acrylic profile badge with luminous gradient edges and clean interface typography
project_info.color_palette: clear glossy glass, pink, purple, orange, electric blue accents, and deep charcoal background

main_subject.type: transparent rectangular glass or acrylic profile card
main_subject.detail: rounded corners, glossy surface, softly glowing neon edge gradient, and a generic illustrated avatar
main_subject.interaction: card held gently between two adult fingers with realistic skin texture and natural contact reflections

composition_elements.framing: vertical close-up product composition with the card centered and fingers entering from the lower edges
composition_elements.interface: fictional social-profile information rendered in modern minimal sans-serif typography
composition_elements.profile_fields: generic display name, handle, bio, website placeholder, join date placeholder, and follower counts with no real personal data
composition_elements.background: dark studio background with controlled neon reflections

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: small soft key at approximately 4200K with magenta, violet, and amber edge lights
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: glowing pink-purple-orange rim, realistic transparent refraction, soft finger highlights, and premium futuristic mood

technical_specs.render_style: macro product photography with 90mm lens, photoreal transparent material and graphic UI
technical_specs.finish: sharp glass edges, realistic fingerprints and reflections, restrained bloom, legible fictional placeholders, and natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic vertical close-up of a transparent social-profile card designed like a futuristic glass ID badge, held gently between two adult fingers. Make the rectangular card rounded-corner clear glossy glass or acrylic with glowing neon edges in a pink, purple, and orange gradient. Display a generic illustrated avatar and fictional profile information using modern minimal sans-serif typography: a generic display name, handle, short bio, placeholder website, placeholder join date, and invented follower counts. Do not include any real platform name, real username, verified badge, phone status, personal data, or official logo. Use a deep charcoal studio background, approximately 4200K soft key light with magenta-violet-amber edge lights, realistic refraction, fingerprints, reflections, and premium product-detail styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, real social platform, real username, real personal data, phone verification, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, broken glass, illegible UI text

Replace the platform, handle, avatar, verification, dates, counts, and all personal data with fictional cleared placeholders; the card must not identify a real person or function as an official ID.
